# Zyvibe

> Zyvibe is a website design and front-end development studio. It designs and builds high-end websites, landing pages and product front-ends for businesses.

## How it works
1. Book a free spot at https://zyvibe.com/#book by answering five questions (name, email, company, what you are building, existing website or projects).
2. Within 24 hours, Zyvibe emails a private link to a working sample landing page built for that business.
3. To launch, a one-time setup fee of $1,999 USD finishes the site and puts it live on the client's domain. A $499 USD per month growth plan starts the month after launch.

## Services
- Landing pages
- Marketing websites
- Product and SaaS front-ends
- Website redesigns
- SEO foundations (metadata, structured data, sitemaps)
- Ongoing growth: new pages, campaign landing pages, design updates, performance care
